name: mosquitto
description: [p]This container is a minimal port of the official [a href='https://mosquitto.org/']Eclipse Mosquitto[/a] Docker container with minor tweaks to work more conveniently in Unraid.[/p] [h4]Configuration[/h4] [p]To set up paths and ports, see the descriptions in the Unraid docker settings page.[/p] [p]To further control mosquitto configuration, place a [code]mosquitto.conf[/code] file in the config path, or start the container one time and it will write a template [code]mosquitto.conf.example[/code] file to the config path for you to copy and edit. For further details, refer to the full README at [a href='https://github.com/cmccambridge/mosquitto-Unraid/blob/master/README.md']https://github.com/cmccambridge/mosquitto-Unraid/blob/master/README.md[/a][/p]

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Store codemosquitto.conf/code (or additional code*.conf/code files). emContainer Path: code/mosquitto/config/code/em

paths.name: Persistent Data Directory
paths.description: em(Optional)/em Store persistent MQTT data. strongNote:/strong Persistent data must be enabled in the codemosquitto.conf/code config file. emContainer Path: code/mosquitto/data/code/em

paths.name: Log Directory
paths.description: em(Optional)/em Store mosquitto logs. strongNote:/strong Logs must be enabled in the codemosquitto.conf/code config file. emContainer Path: code/mosquitto/log/code/em

ports.name: Host Port: MQTT Server
ports.description: MQTT Server Port. emContainer Port: code1883/code/em

ports.name: Host Port: MQTT TLS
ports.description: em(Optional)/em MQTT-TLS Server Port strongNote:/strong TLS must be configured in the codemosquitto.conf/code config file. emContainer Port: code8883/code/em

ports.name: Host Port: MQTT Websockets
ports.description: em(Optional)/em MQTT Websockets Server Port. strongNote:/strong Websockets must be enabled in the codemosquitto.conf/code config file. emContainer Port: code9001/code/em

variables.name: Run Insecure MQTT Server
variables.description: Set to code1/code to enable anonymous connections on port 1883 as in Mosquitto 1.x
